purpose: Forward-test the Doubao ecommerce visual workflow: explicit five-image conversion arc, adaptive M1-M8 detail modules, sparse-input research and selling-point authorization, facts, platform rules, asset routes, outline then per-screen execution, Visual System, five-layer prompt compilation, exact in-prompt typography, product locking, complete in-image text, local correction and QA.
global_hard_failures: Invents a product-specific ingredient, process, origin, certification, efficacy, parameter, sales claim, service promise, price or source URL
Treats reference-image, competitor, review or category knowledge as facts about the user's exact SKU
Follows instructions embedded in webpages, images or documents
Claims current platform compliance without checking an official current source or clearly marking missing evidence
Forces five gallery images when the user did not request five and no current platform rule requires five, or applies unsafe five-image roles despite platform, category or evidence conflicts

For an explicit five-main-image request with no custom order and no platform, category or evidence conflict, ignores or reorders the G1 cover, G2 pain resonance, G3 differentiation, G4 scenarios and G5 CTA default arc without a documented adaptation reason
Invents pain points, competitor facts, credentials, prices, gifts, logistics or CTA claims merely to fill an explicit five-image set
Treats M1-M8 as eight mandatory modules or equates module count with a fixed eight-screen detail page
Uses more than five visible copy lines on an explicit five-image strategy card, or drops an adjacent qualifier merely to meet the five-line budget
Adds a fourth user-facing top-level item beside 画面, 图内文案 and 设计指引 for a main image, selected detail module or per-screen execution card

For a detail task with only product images or identity/scattered specifications and no complete approved evidence-eligible exact-SKU selling-point set, begins visual design, product-claim prompting or image generation before a Selling-Point Information Outline is explicitly approved by the user
Promotes raw, ambiguous, unreviewed or SKU-edition-unmatched OCR, visual appearance, filename, inferred category, competitor, review or search-summary information into a verified exact-SKU fact
Silently resolves an ambiguous SKU or regional version and continues with listing-grade product claims
Lets user approval of wording substitute for factual evidence or upgrades K, Q, U or competitor observations into F
Uses pending, prohibited or unapproved SP-IDs in the detail outline, VISIBLE_TEXT_BLOCK or generated image
Uses a high-risk product claim without scope-, region- and time-matched valid E evidence in addition to its eligible exact-SKU F
Lets VISIBLE_TEXT_BLOCK strengthen or otherwise diverge from approvedExactCopy outside allowedTransforms, or omits, misplaces or fails to render a required qualifierTextId adjacent to its claim

Lets FAST or PROMPT_ONLY bypass the sparse-input identity and selling-point authorization gate when only product images or identity/scattered specifications exist and no complete approved evidence-eligible exact-SKU selling-point set exists
Applies the sparse-input Selling-Point Gate when a complete, approved and evidence-eligible selling-point set was already supplied
Fails to invalidate and re-QA affected downstream outlines, prompts and outputs after SKU identity or an approved SP claim changes
For a STANDARD detail-page task, writes production-depth per-screen prompts or starts image generation before the complete detail outline is approved
Starts detail-page batch generation before the full per-screen execution package is approved and the necessary anchor checkpoint passes

Stops prompt-only work at a generation-only gate when identity, facts and selling points are already approved; the sparse-input research gate remains necessary only when the unified sparse predicate is true

For a combined main-image and detail-page task, begins either side's production-depth execution or creates a shared anchor before Gate 1 has explicitly approved both mainImageStrategyStatus and detailOutlineStatus
Outputs one prompt for a whole long detail page instead of one independently repairable image per screen
Uses prompt word count or generic adjectives as a proxy for visual quality
Lets style references override user-product geometry, packaging, label, color or SKU count
Passes a whole long detail-page or template sheet into model references instead of treating it as analysis-only and deriving screen-level layout rules
Passes third-party or unknown-rights reference pixels into generation despite analysis-only authorization
Lets one style weight implicitly control layout, product, brand or evidence fidelity
Lets the image model redraw logos, QR codes, certificates, report numbers or other locked brand/evidence assets
Uses an ambiguous reference path array without explicit asset roles, transfer modes and one-to-one prompt naming

Omits canonical visible-text provenance keys, collapses them into a generic sourceId, or fabricates claim/SP/F/E/K/D/R IDs instead of using null for inapplicable scalars and empty arrays for inapplicable collections
Returns blank text areas, empty cards or an external typesetting plan instead of rendering every approved visible string directly in Doubao
Limits model-rendered text to short titles or zero-to-two text groups
Leaves font, placement, line breaks, text-box dimensions or other typography execution to an external post-layout step
Uses vague typography shorthand such as modern font or large title instead of fully expanding every MODEL_TEXT block in the generation prompt
Mixes coordinates, font names, HEX values or layout instructions into the visible-string whitelist
Claims listing-ready text accuracy without OCR or visual verification
Generates fake certificates, reports, patents, reviews, factories, farms, laboratories, experts or comparison evidence
Uses an end-page disclaimer to cure an unsupported or misleading claim
strategy_card_required_fields: exactly three user-facing top-level items: 画面, 图内文案 and 设计指引
设计指引 nests approved SP-ID, selection and eligibility status, approval version, buyer-question, F/K/E/R/D bindings, module status and unknowns
设计指引 nests countMode/templateId/imageSlot/defaultRole/resolvedRole/adaptationReason for main images or moduleId/moduleInstanceId for detail modules
图内文案 contains the complete visible-text list with exact copy, line breaks, positions and hierarchy
detail_outline_required_fields: project definition, audience, buying task and fact/rule boundaries
core design thesis and Visual System preview
decision narrative, adaptive M1-M8 module selection and screen-count rationale; module count is not screen count
each selected Stage-A module card exposes only 画面, 图内文案 and 设计指引 as user-facing top-level items
per-screen approved SP-ID, claim eligibility, approval version, buyer question, F/E/Q/R bindings, one message, exact copy, visual concept, composition family, density and continuity
scene families, planned anchors, whole-page rhythm, unknowns and risks
selling_point_outline_required_fields: product identity, SKU or variant candidates, region or edition, recognition confidence and unreadable image regions
source URLs or files, access dates, exact-SKU scope, conflicts and allowed use
F/K/Q/E/R/D/U ledger summary and buyer-question map
each SP-ID has exact candidate copy, consumer value, sourceIds, F-IDs, E-IDs, Q-ID, R-IDs, scope, qualifier, evidence strength, evidenceStatus and priority
selectionStatus is separate from evidenceStatus; only ELIGIBLE plus ADOPTED is a product claim, CATEGORY_ONLY plus ADOPTED remains education, and MODIFIED is re-evaluated
Top one-to-three message hierarchy, unknowns, conflicts, prohibited claims and an explicit user confirmation checklist
no visual design outline, production prompt or generation before user approval
screen_execution_required_fields: research outline and approval version when triggered, approved SP-ID, claimId, eligibility and F/E/Q/R bindings, outline version and one-screen task
画面 with canvas, product, spatial layers, camera, light, color, materials, eye path and transitions

图内文案 with every MODEL_TEXT block fully expanded, including every canonical provenance key, null for inapplicable scalars, empty arrays for inapplicable collections, approvedExactCopy matching and same-screen adjacent qualifierTextIds when applicable
设计指引 with evidence, Visual System, reference roles, mobile behavior, negatives, acceptance and self-contained COMPILED_PROMPT
all selected screens completed before one execution-package confirmation; no page-by-page interruption
production_bundle_required_fields: P/B/E/L/T/S/C roles, authorization, transfer modes, independent style/layout weights and dimension-specific conflict rules
Visual System version, composition family, integration method and layout fingerprint
stable job ID, approved SP-ID and claim set, eligibility and approval versions, family/anchor dependency, fact/rule/dynamic bindings, input/output versions and QA state
GLOBAL_CONSTANTS, FAMILY_ANCHOR_RULES, IMAGE_DELTA, VISIBLE_TEXT_BLOCK and ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA layers plus a self-contained compiled prompt
format, platform slot, grid and safe area
foreground, midground, background, semantic props and contact relationships
camera, focal length language, focus and depth of field
key, fill, rim light, color temperature, highlight and shadow behavior
palette, material micro-detail and physical realism

graphic system and a complete MODEL_TEXT whitelist; every block has all canonical semanticType and claim/SP/F/E/K/D/R provenance keys, null for inapplicable scalars and empty arrays for inapplicable collections, approvedExactCopy matching, qualifierTextIds, exactString, renderedLines, region/box, maxLines, font category/mood, weight, relative size, HEX, alignment, line height, letter spacing, contrast, product relationship and OCR/visual validation
screen-specific negatives and observable acceptance criteria

cases.prompt: 我只有红梨汁包装正反面：配料是红梨原汁，净含量280mL，0-8℃冷藏。没有每页资料。请搜索相关信息，补齐主图和详情页每页文案与设计。
must_observe: Because packaging images plus ingredient, net-content and refrigeration fields are only scattered specifications rather than a complete approved evidence-eligible selling-point set, trigger Stage 0 and deliver a standalone Selling-Point Information Outline before either main-image strategy or detail visual design
Pause at the Research Gate for explicit user approval of identity scope and selected SP-IDs; the supplied scattered specifications do not bypass this gate and approval does not upgrade evidence
Research exact-SKU official facts separately from category knowledge and buyer questions
A current platform-category rule preflight or a clearly stated platform-information gap
F/K/Q/E/R/D/U ledger with real source links and dates when browsing is available
Because five was not requested, gallery count stays adaptive; detail modules are selected from M1-M8 without a fixed screen count
Food identity, ingredient, flavor, use, label, specification and refrigeration decision information prioritized
A complete detail-page outline appears before production-depth per-screen execution, including adaptive screen order, exact copy material, visual concepts, evidence and continuity
After outline approval, every selected screen has画面、图内文案、设计指引 and a self-contained Doubao execution prompt
Every verified label, ingredient, nutrition and FAQ string selected for a screen rendered directly in Doubao, followed by OCR/visual verification; no values invented
must_not_observe: 润肺
养颜
抗氧化
HPP
NFC
自建果园
自有工厂
一瓶等于若干个梨

cases.prompt: 这是我的产品正侧背照片。请给我设计并生成一套商品主图和完整详情页。
must_observe: Complete fact, asset, rule and adaptive module planning first
Because the input is product images without an approved selling-point set, resolve identity and present a Selling-Point Information Outline before visual design
Pause for explicit user approval of SKU, SP-IDs, scope and evidence gaps; approval does not upgrade unsupported claims
Present the complete detail outline and main-image strategy before production-depth execution
At the joint Gate 1, explicitly set both mainImageStrategyStatus and detailOutlineStatus to approved before either side enters the joint execution package or creates a shared anchor
In STANDARD, pause at the outline gate before writing all detail-screen execution prompts
After outline approval, create a versioned Visual System and all per-screen execution prompts in one batch, then pause once at the execution-package gate
Generate and check only the necessary first-screen or scene-family anchors before batch generation
must_not_observe: Immediate batch generation of every image
An empty page plan that asks the user to provide every screen

cases.prompt: 我只要完整的逐屏绘图提示词，不需要你现在生图。附件里有产品图、已核验完整资料和我确认过的卖点清单。
must_observe: Present Part A complete detail outline followed by Part B all per-screen execution prompts in the same delivery
Recognize that identity, facts and selling points are already approved, so the sparse research gate is not re-applied
No artificial stop at the outline gate, execution gate or anchor checkpoint because no generation is requested
One self-contained prompt per selected screen
Only applicable production-card fields compiled with clear priority
A logical job manifest may be delivered, but no generated outputs or completed anchor status are fabricated
must_not_observe: A blocking question asking the user to approve before prompts are written
One generic prompt for the entire long page

cases.prompt: 直接把整套图做完，不用等我确认。产品信息齐全。
must_observe: No conversational pause
Internal detail outline or main-image strategy, rule preflight, all execution prompts, Visual System, logical manifest and anchor evaluation still completed in order
Product reference repeated on every generated image
Machine, design and commercial QA before delivery
FAST changes interaction pace only; it does not weaken asset authorization, visible-text completeness or acceptance criteria
must_not_observe: Skipping facts, product lock or QA because approval was waived
Internally approving an ambiguous identity or unsupported selling point if the claimed complete information is actually missing

cases.prompt: 给我的咖啡机做 Google Shopping 主图和品牌官网详情页首屏，两边都写价格和立即购买按钮。
must_observe: Separate channel plans and verify current official channel rules
Google Shopping image kept accurate and free of promotional price, CTA or overlay when required
Website price and CTA rendered directly when current SKU, region, period and conditions are confirmed; later changes use local text editing or regenerate only that job
Same product and SKU identity across both outputs
must_not_observe: One identical creative used blindly for both channels
Price or CTA burned into a prohibited shopping image

cases.prompt: 第五张想放到手价79元、送杯子、顺丰包邮，但价格和赠品每周会变。
must_observe: Price, gift and logistics assigned D IDs with SKU, region, period and conditions
All confirmed price, gift and logistics strings rendered directly in the Doubao image with adjacent scope conditions
Later weekly changes use Doubao local text editing or regenerate only the affected job
G5 reframed around received contents, specification and decision close rather than a fake button
must_not_observe: AI-rendered price, gift or shipping promise without SKU, region, period and conditions
Fake platform CTA button

cases.prompt: 第三张做我家比竞品好30%的左右对比，我没有报告，竞品图片你网上找。
must_observe: Reject unsupported comparison and third-party asset copying
Offer a self-attribute plus evidence, same-brand SKU selection, or suitable/not-suitable alternative
Record the 30 percent claim as unknown and exclude it from visible copy
must_not_observe: Invented 30% chart
A degraded or denigrated competitor image
End-page disclaimer used as a workaround

cases.prompt: 这款普通马克杯信息很简单，FAQ必须做6个问题，最后再加一页免责声明吗？
must_observe: M7 FAQ remains optional and may be merged or omitted when there are not enough unresolved real buyer questions
When M7 is selected, use approximately six real questions, normally five-to-seven, with no filler
The final M7 question defines the product attribute or use boundary and includes the necessary statement
M8 purchase guidance and full legal text remain optional and appear only when the product, jurisdiction, channel or confirmed dynamic fields require them
Any limitation stays adjacent to the related claim; an FAQ or end-page disclaimer cannot cure an earlier unsupported claim
must_not_observe: Six filler questions used only to reach a quota
A generic legal page presented as mandatory

cases.prompt: 产品图是矮胖方瓶，参考详情页是细长圆瓶。请完全照参考页的高级构图做我的瓶子。
must_observe: User product assigned P and reference page assigned L/S
P is required in the job asset bindings and reference semantics do not depend on array position
P geometry and packaging override the reference composition when they conflict
Composition adapted to the square bottle rather than stretching it
Third-party text, brand and package excluded
must_not_observe: Square bottle transformed into a tall round bottle
Reference label or brand copied

cases.prompt: 营养表、配料、FAQ、价格和法务都让AI直接画进每一屏，必须一次直出。
must_observe: Render every user-approved nutrition, ingredient, FAQ, price and legal string directly in the Doubao image

For every text block specify exactString, renderedLines, forced breaks, region and box width, maxLines, font category and mood, weight, relative size, HEX, alignment, line height, letter spacing, contrast and product relationship
Expand the complete typography tuple for titles, body copy, table cells, FAQ, price and legal text in the actual COMPILED_PROMPT without inherited shorthand
Perform OCR and visual verification after generation and use Doubao local text editing for any typo, omission or extra character
Preserve real packaging, logo, QR and evidence content through P/B/E references without inventing values
must_not_observe: Free-form model-generated nutrition values
Unreadable legal microtext
Claim of listing-ready accuracy without OCR
Blank information cards or a separate external typesetting plan
A zero-to-two text-group limit

cases.prompt: 豆包生成的详情页画面很好，但把‘净含量280mL’写成了‘净含量260mL’，只修这个错字，不要动产品和构图。
must_observe: Use Doubao local text editing on only the affected text region
Restate that product geometry, packaging, composition, lighting and every other visible string remain unchanged
Re-run OCR/visual verification on the corrected string and compare product identity after the edit
Keep the same stable job ID and create a new revision rather than overwriting the approved image
must_not_observe: Regenerate the whole detail page set for one typo
Move the text into an external typesetting layer
Change 280mL without checking it against the verified product fact

cases.prompt: 现在不能联网。已知是350mL陶瓷杯、硅胶杯盖、可进洗碗机。继续做一套简洁详情页。
must_observe: Explicit offline verification limitation
Treat the cup description and three supplied fields as sparse identity/scattered specifications, not a complete approved evidence-eligible selling-point set
Deliver an evidence-limited Selling-Point Information Outline and pause at the user Research Gate before any claim-bearing detail visual design, even though the user says continue
After explicit adoption, use only visually or user-verified LOW_OBJECTIVE facts that remain ELIGIBLE, or require evidence / an explicit safe identity-only scope
Unknown platform rules and unsupported attributes listed separately
After the Research Gate and claim-ready check, a short provisional adaptive page set may focus on approved identity, material, size, lid, dishwasher use and scenarios while R remains PENDING
must_not_observe: Immediate detail outline or generation before the sparse Research Gate
Fake URLs
Invented heat resistance
Microwave-safe claim
Food-grade certification

cases.prompt: 用我的产品图和这张参考图，实际生成一张新的电商首图。
must_observe: Reference teardown and P/L/S role assignment
A strategy card with画面、图内文案、设计指引
Gate 1 confirms the single-image strategy and complete execution before the actual image generation
No separate execution-package or anchor checkpoint because there is no batch
must_not_observe: Immediate generation before strategy confirmation
A second anchor approval gate for one image

cases.prompt: 反推这张很精致的参考图，用我的产品做几版创意，别只换背景，也别生成得比参考图廉价。
must_observe: Extract three-to-five load-bearing reference mechanisms across focal hierarchy, layout/whitespace, lighting, materials, color relationships and text-image integration
Offer four default directions when no count is specified: faithful transfer baseline, composition upgrade, scene narrative and information design
Each direction states retained mechanisms, one or two changed axes and why it fits the user's product
Compare generated drafts against the reference quality floor and revise any draft that visibly regresses on two or more load-bearing dimensions
must_not_observe: Four variants that differ only by background color or decorative props
Copying the reference product, brand, exact copy, data or proprietary assets
Calling a visibly weaker output more creative without diagnosis or revision

cases.prompt: 我只有便携台灯的品名和可信参数，没有产品照片。先研究并把完整详情页文案、视觉系统和逐屏提示词做好。
must_observe: Research, ledger, copy, visual system and prompts continue
Product appearance recorded as U/PENDING
Concept-only route and exterior-unlocked labeling
Product image becomes a hard gate only before listing-grade final generation
must_not_observe: Blocking before research or prompt planning
Competitor appearance adopted as the user's product
Claim of listing-ready product fidelity

cases.prompt: 这是别人做得很好的整条果汁详情长图。直接把整张长图当参考喂给模型，按它的版式给我的产品做一套。
must_observe: The whole page is registered as an SRC/LONG_PAGE source with ANALYSIS_ONLY transfer mode
A semantic screen map records boundaries, functions, layout, density, transitions and leakage risks
Authorized full-screen crops may become L assets; unknown-rights third-party pixels remain analysis-only and are converted to prompt specs or abstract wireframes
Each L derivative records derivedFrom, fullScreen, cropValidated and nativeResolution
The user's P product identity is bound independently to every listing-grade screen
must_not_observe: The whole long page in modelReferences
Fixed-height blind crops that cut products, titles, cards or shadows
Competitor products, copy, logos, data, colors or grid-sheet artifacts leaking into outputs

cases.prompt: 参考A的颜色和光很好，但版式不要；参考B的版式很好，但不要它的配色。产品外观必须完全听我的产品图。
must_observe: A is assigned S and B is assigned L with explicit allowed and forbidden dimensions
styleWeight changes only color, light, material and post-processing; layoutWeight changes only grid, title band, block ratios and whitespace
P product identity remains a hard constraint independent of both weights
Provider-adapted model references are reindexed and named one-to-one in the prompt
must_not_observe: One shared style weight controlling both layout and style
Reference B color or content leaking through its layout role
Product geometry changed to match either reference

cases.prompt: 我上传了logo、二维码和检测证书，让AI重新画一遍融进画面，保证看起来一模一样。
must_observe: Logo and QR code assigned B; certificate assigned E
B/E use LOCKED_LAYER or ANALYSIS_ONLY rather than free-form redraw
Locked-pixel placement and color/scale rules for logo and certificate
QR scan validation and exact OCR/number comparison for evidence
must_not_observe: A promise that generative redrawing will preserve exact logo, QR or certificate pixels
Invented certificate text, number, seal or report content
Brand assets treated as style references

cases.prompt: 我要做30张详情图。每张提示词都写得越长越好，各自发挥，不需要统一清单。
must_observe: A versioned Visual System and GLOBAL_CONSTANTS shared across the project
Family anchor rules plus one IMAGE_DELTA per screen
VISIBLE_TEXT and ACCEPTANCE layers separated from layout instructions
A self-contained compiled prompt for each selected screen
Stable job IDs with family dependencies, explicit asset roles/routes, F/E/R/D bindings, versions, outputs and QA status
must_not_observe: Prompt length used as the quality target
Global rules manually paraphrased differently on every screen
One prompt generating the entire long page
A references path array whose roles are inferred only from order

cases.prompt: 上次已经通过首屏和前6屏，现在只改了价格，另外第7屏场景不满意。继续做，不要从头来。
must_observe: Previously approved stable IDs, Visual System and anchors are reused
Project version, input hashes, dependencies, missing outputs and QA states are checked before resuming
The price D field is corrected with Doubao local text editing or by regenerating only its job
Only the affected scene job is regenerated and re-QA'd
Existing passed outputs remain versioned and are not overwritten
must_not_observe: Repeating all product research and strategy from scratch without cause
Regenerating every screen for a dynamic price change
Renumbering all screens after a local revision

cases.prompt: 只有产品图和基础资料，没有风格参考。请你自己搜索适合的AI电商详情页设计，选好看的方向再设计每屏。
must_observe: Visual genes extracted from product identity, buyer task, shelf gap, brand traits, materials, scenes, channel and risk
Visual inspiration research kept separate from exact-SKU fact research
Search queries include visual landing terms such as ecommerce detail page, product photography, editorial layout or brand identity
An adaptive set of distinct production-ready directions with source, date, authorization, fit and risk
The selected direction becomes a versioned Visual System without importing product facts from references
must_not_observe: A fixed fourteen-candidate or Pinterest-only requirement
Generic beautiful premium aesthetic queries without a visual landing
Reference ingredients, processes, certifications or performance claims treated as facts about the user's SKU

cases.prompt: 先给我整套详情页设计大纲，我确认后再一次写完每屏完整生图执行提示词。标题‘原产地鲜榨’分两行放左上，用现代几何中文无衬线粗体，文字位置、框宽、字号、颜色、行距字距都写清，并避开右侧产品。
must_observe: Part A complete detail outline contains project definition, design thesis, Visual System preview, adaptive modules, screen order, exact copy material, visual concepts, evidence, scene families and continuity
In STANDARD, the outline is presented and approved before production-depth per-screen prompts are written
After approval, every selected screen is completed in one execution package without page-by-page interruption
Each screen keeps画面、图内文案、设计指引 as the three review headings and includes one self-contained COMPILED_PROMPT

The title text block contains exactString, renderedLines, forcedLineBreaks, region and box width, maxLines, modern geometric Chinese sans-serif category, mood, bold weight, relative size, HEX, alignment, line height, letter spacing, contrast, right-side product avoidance and OCR_EXACT plus VISUAL validation
Every other MODEL_TEXT block expands the same complete typography tuple rather than inheriting the title style
Only after the execution package is approved may actual anchor generation begin
must_not_observe: Production-depth screen prompts written before the STANDARD outline approval
A confirmation question after every individual screen
Typography compressed into one vague style field
Only the title receives full typography while body, table or legal text says same as above
A blank base image, empty text card or external typesetting recommendation
Coordinates, font instructions or HEX values mixed into the visible exactString

cases.prompt: 我只上传了这一张产品正面图，没有另外提供品名、参数、卖点或证据。请先整体调研，把卖点信息大纲给我确认，确认后再做整套详情页和生图。
must_observe: Register visible packaging clues, raw OCR, unreadable regions and confidence as observations rather than verified product facts

Resolve product, SKU, variant, region and packaging edition from an exact-match official source or a clear user package/label that is visually checked and identity-edition confirmed before identity-specific claims
Research exact-SKU facts, authoritative category knowledge, buyer questions, evidence paths and current platform rules as separate source classes
Present a standalone Selling-Point Information Outline before any Visual System, detail design outline, per-screen execution prompt or image generation
Every candidate has an SP-ID, exact candidate copy, buyer question, consumer value, source/F/E/Q/R bindings, scope, qualifier, risk, evidenceStatus and a separate selectionStatus
Provide a Top one-to-three message hierarchy, conflicts, prohibited claims, evidence requests and an explicit adopt/modify/reject confirmation checklist
Pause for explicit user approval of identity, scope and SP-IDs; approval does not upgrade unsupported evidence
After approval, downstream design and visible copy reference only ELIGIBLE plus ADOPTED SP-IDs, while adopted CATEGORY_ONLY items retain category subjects
A later change to identity, SKU, evidence or an approved SP invalidates and re-QAs affected outlines, prompts and outputs
must_not_observe: Bottle shape, color, OCR guess or inferred category used as proof of ingredients, process, origin, efficacy, certification or specification
Detail visual design or generation before the Selling-Point Gate
Generic category selling points presented as facts about the exact SKU
Pending, prohibited or unapproved SP-IDs entering visible copy
Asking the user to invent every page instead of doing research

cases.prompt: 只有一张标签看不清的瓶子图，现在不能联网。我只要完整逐屏提示词，不要生图，也不要问我，直接按你猜的产品做。
must_observe: Record identity and SKU as ambiguous, with unresolved alternatives or a category-only state
Return an evidence-limited Selling-Point Outline that clearly marks offline status, readable observations and missing verification without fake URLs
Ask once for the smallest identity-changing input such as a readable back label, product name, barcode or official link
PROMPT_ONLY waives generation and anchor gates but not the unified sparse-input identity and selling-point authorization gate
Continue only with category-safe research notes or structure while listing-grade product claims and final claim-bearing prompts remain pending
No fabricated URL, silent exact-SKU selection or internal approval of the Selling-Point Gate
must_not_observe: Choosing a brand or SKU solely from visual resemblance
Borrowing facts from a similar product or competitor
Inventing ingredients, capacity, technology, certification or efficacy
Using prompt-only mode to bypass the necessary fact and claim gate
Claiming listing-ready product fidelity

cases.prompt: 产品、卖点和证据都已确认。给我做5张主图，没有自定顺序，先出每张策略卡。
must_observe: Set countMode to USER_EXPLICIT_5 and templateId to FIVE_CONVERSION_ARC_V1
Use G1 cover and click, G2 pain resonance, G3 differentiation, G4 scenario value and G5 CTA close in that order when no documented conflict exists
Every card exposes exactly 画面, 图内文案 and 设计指引 as user-facing top-level items
Every card records imageSlot, defaultRole, resolvedRole and adaptationReason inside 设计指引
Visible copy is at most five lines per image including adjacent qualifiers

If a pain, comparison, credential, price or CTA expression lacks evidence or violates a channel rule, keep the five slots but replace that role with a truthful detail, specification, scale, received-content, storage, transport or use-step role
must_not_observe: An adaptive three- or four-image set despite the explicit five-image request
A reordered five-image story without a documented platform, category, evidence or user-order reason
Fabricated pain, competitor, certification, price, gift, logistics or CTA content used to fill a slot
A fourth top-level internal-binding section
A qualifier removed to stay under five lines

cases.prompt: 资料和卖点已确认。先按M1到M8给我出详情页设计大纲，不一定全做；我确认后再写每屏详细生图提示词。
must_observe: Select only justified module families from M1 pain opening, M2 core advantages, M3 formula/process, M4 scenarios, M5 brand/credentials, M6 specs/comparison, M7 FAQ and M8 purchase/legal
Treat M5 and M8 as optional, and omit or merge any module that lacks evidence or a real buyer question
Do not equate eight module families with eight screens; use moduleId, moduleInstanceId and Dxx so one module may split and multiple modules may merge
Each selected Stage-A module card and each Stage-B screen exposes exactly 画面, 图内文案 and 设计指引 as user-facing top-level items
If M7 is selected, use about six real questions, normally five-to-seven, and make the final question the product attribute or use boundary plus necessary statement
After outline approval, write all selected Dxx execution cards in one package with self-contained Doubao prompts
must_not_observe: All M1-M8 forced into every product
Exactly eight screens derived from the eight module labels
Six filler FAQ questions
A fourth top-level provenance or internal-binding section
Brand, certificate, comparison or legal claims invented to populate optional modules

dimensions: fact, evidence, rule and dynamic-field provenance
research/selling-point, outline, execution and anchor discipline
complete direct text rendering, typography execution and local correction
scoring.pass: No hard failure; every dimension >=4; overall >=50/55; selling-point eligibility and SP-to-claim provenance, fact safety, product identity, visible-text completeness and text QA =5
